name: Huntington Bancshares

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Huntington Bancshares Inc. logo.svg)

description: Huntington is a Columbus, Ohio regional bank holding company ($225.1B of assets, $176.6B of deposits at 2025-12-31) that lends to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients in the Midwest and increasingly beyond, marketing itself on 'Fair Play' customer-friendly banking. It earns 73 percent of revenue from net interest income (spread on loans and deposits) and the rest from fees on cards, payments, treasury services and wealth management. It is growing by acquisition: Veritex (Dallas) closed 2025-10-20 and Cadence Bank (Houston and Tupelo) closed 2026-02-01, neither fully in the 2025 numbers.

employees.asOf: 2025 (average full-time equivalent colleagues during the year)
employees.note: Average FTE, not a year-end count (10-K).

businessLines.name: Consumer & Regional Banking
businessLines.how: Consumers and small-to-mid-sized businesses pay loan interest (direct and indirect consumer, dealer finance, mortgage, home equity, SBA) and fees for deposits, cards, payments, treasury services, wealth management and brokerage through branches, digital and partner channels; 74 percent of revenue is net interest income (4,127 of 5,551, computed).

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net income attributable to Huntington

businessLines.name: Commercial Banking
businessLines.how: Commercial and corporate clients pay loan interest and deposit spread plus fees; 74 percent of revenue is net interest income (2,150 of 2,911, computed). Noncontrolling-interest income of 18 is deducted from net income.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net income attributable to Huntington

businessLines.name: Treasury / Other
businessLines.how: Not a customer business: funding, securities and unallocated items.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), net loss attributable to Huntington

brands.name: Fair Play banking
brands.note: Product suite brand (24-Hour Grace, Asterisk-Free Checking, $50 Safety Zone and others) used to acquire customers.

brands.name: Veritex Holdings (Dallas, Texas)
brands.note: Acquisition completed 2025-10-20; Veritex Community Bank merged into Huntington National Bank.

brands.name: Cadence Bank (Houston, Texas and Tupelo, Mississippi)
brands.note: Acquisition completed 2026-02-01, 100 percent stock at 2.475 Huntington shares per Cadence share, valued at about $8.1B at the 2026-01-30 close of $17.48.
